content.json:
# Identity Risk Dashboard

A Microsoft Sentinel view of sign-in outcomes, potential repeated MFA failures, sensitive identity administration and OAuth consent activity.

> Repeated authentication failures are investigation indicators and do not, by themselves, prove an MFA-fatigue attack.

parameters.name: Workspace
parameters.label: Workspace
parameters.description: Select the Log Analytics workspace containing Entra SigninLogs and AuditLogs.

content.query:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend
    Outcome = iff(ResultType == "0", "Successful", "Unsuccessful"),
    Reason = case(
        ResultType == "0", "Successful sign-in",
        ResultType == "65001", "Application consent required",
        ResultType == "50097", "Device authentication required",
        ResultType == "50140", "Keep me signed in interruption",
        ResultType == "500121", "MFA authentication failed",
        isempty(ResultDescription), strcat("Other result: ", ResultType),
        ResultDescription
    )
| summarize SignIns = count() by Reason, Outcome
| project Reason, SignIns, Outcome
| order by SignIns desc
content.title: Sign-in outcomes and access-control interruptions

content.query:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ResultType == "500121"
| summarize
    FailureEvents = dcount(CorrelationId)
    by
        UserPrincipalName,
        IPAddress,
        bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where FailureEvents >= 3
| summarize PotentialPatterns = count()
content.title: Potential repeated MFA-failure patterns

content.query:
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Result =~ "success"
| extend TargetProperties = tostring(TargetResources)
| where OperationName in~ (
    "Add member to role",
    "Remove member from role",
    "Add eligible member to role",
    "Remove eligible member from role",
    "Add app role assignment grant to user",
    "Remove app role assignment grant from user",
    "Reset user password",
    "Delete user",
    "User registered security info",
    "Admin registered security info",
    "Delete user authentication method",
    "Add Conditional Access policy",
    "Update Conditional Access policy",
    "Delete Conditional Access policy"
)
or (
    OperationName =~ "Update user"
    and TargetProperties has_any (
        "AccountEnabled",
        "StrongAuthentication",
        "UserPrincipalName",
        "PasswordProfile"
    )
)
| extend Initiator = coalesce(
    tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName),
    tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName),
    "Unknown"
)
| summarize
    Events = count(),
    DistinctInitiators = dcount(Initiator),
    LatestEvent = max(TimeGenerated)
    by OperationName
| order by Events desc
content.title: Sensitive identity administration

content.query:
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where OperationName =~ "Consent to application"
| where Result =~ "success"
| mv-expand TargetResource = TargetResources
| mv-expand Property = TargetResource.modifiedProperties
| where tostring(Property.displayName) ==
    "ConsentAction.Permissions"
| extend
    Application = tostring(TargetResource.displayName),
    PermissionChange = tostring(Property.newValue)
| extend GrantedScopes = extract(
    @"(?i)Scope:\s+([^,\]]+)",
    1,
    PermissionChange
)
| summarize
    ConsentEvents = dcount(CorrelationId),
    LatestEvent = max(TimeGenerated),
    GrantedScopes = make_set(GrantedScopes, 10)
    by Application
| order by ConsentEvents desc
content.title: OAuth consent activity
